readOnlyReason.description: why a read-only daemon is read-only (commands off, another pr-review holds the data dir, or the engine failed to open), for display

fix.description: what to run or set, for display; never a secret

checks.description: the daemon's readiness checks, computed for this hello; absent from older servers and fixture servers

archivedAt.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp: when a reader archived the PR; absent unless it is archived, and cleared when a review is started on it

attempt.description: 1-based: each manual retry or approval opens the next attempt

line.description: head-revision line; null for a file-level finding

stale.description: the anchor's head SHA is no longer the PR head; never silently remapped

unconfirmed.description: true when the reviewer suspects the finding but could not show it from the cited code alone; absent for a confirmed finding

ghActive.description: gh's own active account for this host

selected.description: the account this data dir uses for GitHub reads and publishing

accounts.description: absent from servers that predate account selection

prevSequence.description: sequence of the previous event this server emitted, or the snapshot's sequence
